rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name and ZIP and accessed the correct delivered order. However, it failed to honor the user’s explicit constraint to keep all other specifications the same except maximizing zoom. The selected replacement changed the resolution from 24MP to 30MP (storage remained SD), violating the requirement. Additionally, before performing the exchange write, the agent did not restate the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation to proceed, as required by policy; it proceeded after only asking for the payment method. While the price difference calculation and PayPal usage were correct and the exchange tool call succeeded, these policy and requirement deviations mean the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
